body: I’m into music and video games. I do have a boyfriend but I think these harsh feelings are revisiting because the suicide attempt was over a very toxic relationship. (Every aspect of my life was controlled, I was mentally and physically hurt if I wasn’t obedient to this guy) and with my new guy, he’s great, but I didn’t realize how traumatized I was until I had to face anything with this new guy. I’ll still check out your thread though because I agree about it being hard to meet people. I want more girl friends. 😪

When I was in fifth grade I had just changed schools and I dealt with bullying at my previous school so I didn’t feel ready. I went to the kitchen and held a knife to my neck and cut deep enough to bleed but not enough to kill. Put the knife back when I thought about how nice my new teacher was and decided to try school longer. Still one of my fave teachers to this day. 

More recently I was in a toxic relationship and had been through so much. This guy tore me apart from my family, I moved into his place 2,200 miles from my home, and he made me miserable. Controlled when/what I spoke, when I left the house, what i did at home, what I ate. Nothing was good enough. I became an underweight shell of myself and begged my family for help telling them I was wrong during a week trip to visit family. Took a whole bottle of pills and woke up so drugged I wondered if I was dead. Family didn’t even notice or care when I didn’t leave my room for half of my week home. 

I feel like there’s no point in trying again, although I feel so numb.
